witos.Platform.KnownOperatingSystem: WitOS is neither Windows, Linux, macOS nor FreeBSD: an application that infers Windows from 'not Linux and not macOS' misbehaves there (RFC 0015 §1, ADR 0024).
witos.FileIO.Watcher: System.IO.FileSystem.Watcher is not supported: the namespace service sends no change notifications (Compatibility-Differences: File change notifications).
